title: Embassy of India — identification of mortal remains (1 Sep 2026)
citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — Press Release (1 September 2026)
body: Embassy of India, Kathmandu (1 Sep 2026): guidance on identification and handover of mortal remains after the Nepal flash floods. Relatives may check photos and descriptions on the Nepal Police UDB disaster portal (udb.nepalpolice.gov.np/disaster). For DNA matching of interred remains, first-degree relatives can email profiles to dnacodis@nepalpolice.gov.np and CC eoikathmandufloodsupport@gmail.com; relatives in Nepal may give blood samples to authorities. Nepal Police helpline: +977-9841616095. Embassy helplines (WhatsApp): +977-9851316807, +977-9709107500, +977-9810326117. Handover follows a nine-step Nepal government process including documentation, post-mortem, identification, DNA/fingerprint collection, and embassy coordination.
